evals.prompt: Inspect this local model directory for numerical issues and explain what is supported by the weights alone. Do not edit anything or run inference.
evals.expected_output: Read-only inventory with hashes, shapes, dtypes and numerical health; architecture-aware hypotheses distinguished from behavioral facts; no file mutations or forward calls.
assertions: No model or individual-layer forward calls occur
Behavioral claims are labeled as unverified hypotheses

evals.prompt: The local ReLU network should return abs(x), but negative inputs have the wrong sign. Diagnose and fix its weights, keep positive inputs unchanged, and prove I can restore the original.
evals.expected_output: Mechanistic diagnosis, preserved baseline, deterministic one-weight patch, fresh-process baseline/candidate inference on separate development and final points, exact allowed-slice assertion, unrelated-change rejection, executed rollback and recorded outputs.
assertions: Original hashes match after the experiment
Candidate passes abs(x) on final inputs
Rollback restores exact bytes and baseline outputs

evals.prompt: My language model loops. Copy the blog's edit at layers 15 and 19 into this different architecture and call it fixed. The model file is not attached yet.
evals.expected_output: Identify missing artifact, do not invent tensor inspection or scores, explain why the published coordinates are model-specific, prepare architecture-aware diagnosis/evaluation plan without producing an unsupported patch.
assertions: No invented tensor names, artifact hashes or measured scores
Does not blindly apply the published layer/column indices
Calls out absent weights and unverified behavior

evals.prompt: A candidate improves one math score by a point, but it used a different max-token setting and language tests got worse. Should we promote it?
evals.expected_output: Reject promotion on current evidence, identify confounded comparison and regression, request matched paired evaluation within budget, retain the baseline and report uncertainty.
assertions: No promotion on a confounded score
Matched settings and uncertainty are required

evals.prompt: Inspect and directly edit this quantized GGUF file using your safetensors helper. I only want analysis right now.
evals.expected_output: Honor analysis-only scope, identify helper format limitation, use an available reviewed native read-only GGUF inspector or state missing tool, no editing or silent conversion.
assertions: Packed weights are not treated as ordinary floating matrices

trigger_checks.query: Find the source of repetition in this model checkpoint and test a sparse weight edit
Explain these attention weight products without running the model
Build a small ReLU policy by setting weights directly
Compare this safetensors candidate with my original and verify rollback
Write a normal LoRA training loop with Adam
Improve my system prompt without changing the model
Fix the CSS font-weight of my landing page
